about.title: About
paragraphs: I design and build backend and data platforms that sit at the heart of products — orchestrating ERP, payments, logistics, and analytics so businesses can move faster with confidence.

My experience spans cloud‑native ERP transformation, ML‑driven growth experiments, fraud analytics, and event‑driven architectures. I enjoy working close to the business: turning ambiguous requirements into measurable impact, with a strong bias for shipping.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: A blend of backend engineering, data platforms, and product‑centric problem solving.

items.title: Senior Software Engineer (SDE‑2)
items.summary: Leading the ERP POD and driving the evolution of a monolithic ERP into a distributed, cloud‑native platform on AWS, powering supply chain, finance, and warehouse operations across B2B and B2C.
points: Architected and scaled ERP into a **distributed AWS‑native system** (including AWS Lambda), improving resilience, scalability, and performance for core business workflows.
Built and integrated **mission‑critical backend systems** including banking/payment APIs, AMC lifecycle automation, and an Order Management System (OMS) for end‑to‑end order flow.
Designed inventory tracking workflows and **data pipelines** that surfaced mid‑mile logistics leakages, helping prevent ~**₹10 Lakhs** in losses.
Implemented **DevOps & observability best practices** with Kibana‑backed logging and automated CI/CD using GitHub APIs and LLM‑powered code reviews.

items.title: Associate Consultant
items.summary: Worked across insurance and marketing analytics projects, combining data engineering, ML, and reporting to drive better customer acquisition and fraud detection.
points: For **HDFC ERGO**, engineered a supervised ML model to target WhatsApp communications, achieving a **70% reduction in messaging costs** and higher lead conversion.
Partnered with marketing and engineering to build a **multi‑channel data pipeline** (email, SMS, WhatsApp), resulting in a **6% uplift** in lead conversion.
For **Star Health Insurance**, developed ETL workflows, DDS (Detail Data Store), reporting, and dashboards using SQL & SAS in production environments.
Contributed to **fraud detection** by combining data warehousing, algorithms, and API‑driven rule engines.
